name: ennodia
description: Local MCP server for AI team advice, multi-agent review, Compare, and traceable receipts

tools.name: ennodia_list_harnesses
tools.description: Discover supported local AI harnesses and report availability, runnable state, command path, version, capabilities, and adapter notes. Use first when setup or routing fails.

refresh.description: Re-scan available harnesses instead of returning the short-lived discovery cache.

tools.name: ennodia_list_skills
tools.description: Discover prompt-only skills from project, user, and built-in skill directories without returning full instruction text.

cwd.description: Optional working directory to locate project-specific skills.

tools.name: ennodia_install_skills
tools.description: Install bundled Ennodia Agent Skills into native harness skill directories. Defaults to dryRun so clients can inspect planned writes before applying them.

skillIds.description: Bundled skill IDs to install. Omit to install every bundled Ennodia skill.

harnessIds.description: Native harness skill locations to install into. Omit to target Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, and Antigravity.

scope.description: Install into project-local or user-global skill directories.

cwd.description: Project directory used when scope is project.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing skill folder at the target path.

dryRun.description: Preview planned writes without copying files. Set false to install.

tools.name: ennodia_plan
tools.description: Classify a prompt and preview the route Ennodia would take without starting any child process. Use before ennodia_run when you want to inspect routing.

prompt.description: The task to classify and route.

category.description: Optional caller-provided route category. Pass this when you know the task category; Ennodia then skips keyword classification.

includeMermaid.description: Include the presentational Mermaid route diagram.

tools.name: ennodia_start_plan_advice
tools.description: Ask one Advisor to propose a bounded team of harness, model, and skill assignments. This starts only the Advisor task: its output is strict, inert plan data that Ennodia validates and never executes automatically. Poll ennodia_get_plan_advice, then explicitly call ennodia_start_advised_plan with the returned digest.

prompt.description: The work for which the Advisor should propose a team.

cwd.description: Optional target working directory used only to discover available skills. The Advisor task runs in a separate empty temporary directory.

refresh.description: Re-scan harnesses before freezing the Advisor inventory snapshot.

advisorHarnessId.description: Harness to run the Plan Advisor. Omit to use the default priority: claude-code, codex, antigravity, opencode, kilo, kiro, cline, then hermes-agent.

advisorModel.description: Optional model override for the Plan Advisor task.

allowedHarnessIds.description: Worker harness IDs the Advisor may select. Omit to allow every runnable public Ennodia adapter.

allowedModels.description: Exact caller-approved worker model IDs by harness. A model omitted by the Advisor uses that harness's default.

maxSlices.description: Maximum explicit worker slices the Advisor may propose.

maxSkillsPerSlice.description: Maximum installed native skills assigned to one slice.

maxTotalSkillAssignments.description: Maximum skill assignments across the complete plan.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout for the single Plan Advisor task in milliseconds, capped at one hour.

maxEstimatedInputTokens.description: Fail before starting if the estimated run input tokens exceed this value.

maxChildTasks.description: Fail before starting if routing selects more child harness tasks than this value.

budget.description: Optional preflight budget limits for an Ennodia operation.

tools.name: ennodia_list_plan_advice
tools.description: List recent Plan Advisor requests started by this Ennodia MCP server process.

includeProposal.description: Include the untrusted model-authored proposal when available.

includePlan.description: Include the validated inert execution plan when ready.

includeEvents.description: Include bounded Plan Advisor event history.

maxEvents.description: Maximum Plan Advisor events per item when includeEvents is true.

tools.name: ennodia_get_plan_advice
tools.description: Inspect Plan Advisor status, validation issues, frozen inventory identity, proposal, validated plan, digest, budgets, events, and ETA. A plan can be launched only when status is ready. An authorized plan has status consumed and cannot run again.

adviceId.description: Plan advice ID returned by ennodia_start_plan_advice.

includeProposal.description: Include the untrusted model-authored proposal when available.

includePlan.description: Include the validated inert execution plan when ready.

includeEvents.description: Include bounded Plan Advisor event history.

maxEvents.description: Maximum Plan Advisor events to include. Use 0 to omit events.

tools.name: ennodia_cancel_plan_advice
tools.description: Cancel a running Plan Advisor request and its Advisor task.

adviceId.description: Plan advice ID returned by ennodia_start_plan_advice.

tools.name: ennodia_start_advised_plan
tools.description: Explicitly launch the exact validated worker plan from a ready Plan Advisor request. Ennodia re-checks the caller-supplied digest, current harness and skill inventory, caller allowlisted model assignments, and budget before starting the first worker task; any mismatch fails closed with zero launches. A plan is single-use after authorization. Provider model availability remains unverified until the harness runs.

adviceId.description: Ready plan advice ID returned by ennodia_start_plan_advice.

expectedPlanDigest.description: Exact planDigest returned by ennodia_get_plan_advice for explicit, stale-plan-safe execution.

cwd.description: Working directory for worker tasks. Omit to reuse the directory whose skills were inventoried.

isolateCwd.description: Run each worker against an ephemeral isolated copy of cwd so parallel writes cannot clobber each other. Isolation fails before task spawn if the copied tree contains a symbolic link. The execution path is reported as the task cwd for traceability and deleted when the task becomes terminal.

timeoutMs.description: Per-worker timeout in milliseconds, capped at one hour.

maxEstimatedInputTokens.description: Fail before starting if the estimated run input tokens exceed this value.

maxChildTasks.description: Fail before starting if routing selects more child harness tasks than this value.

budget.description: Optional preflight budget limits for an Ennodia operation.

tools.name: ennodia_estimate_budget
tools.description: Estimate the input-token budget for a planned Ennodia run and report whether optional limits would be exceeded before starting child tasks.

prompt.description: The user task to route and estimate.

category.description: Optional caller-provided route category. Pass this when you know the task category; Ennodia then skips keyword classification.

harnessId.description: Force one harness by ID for the estimate, such as opencode or claude-code.

mode.description: auto follows the planner; single estimates one selected harness; parallel estimates all candidate harnesses.

compare.description: Whether the Judge + Result Advisor comparison should be included in the estimate. auto follows the planner.

refresh.description: Re-scan harnesses before planning the estimate.

maxOutputChars.description: Maximum characters from each successful task output assumed for Judge + Result Advisor input.

maxEstimatedInputTokens.description: Fail before starting if the estimated run input tokens exceed this value.

maxChildTasks.description: Fail before starting if routing selects more child harness tasks than this value.

budget.description: Optional preflight budget limits for an Ennodia operation.

tools.name: ennodia_estimate_compositional_budget
tools.description: Resolve focused compositional slices to harnesses and estimate child-task and later Judge + Result Advisor budget without starting child processes.

prompt.description: Overall task or question that every slice belongs to.

id.description: Optional stable slice ID returned with the started task. Must be unique when supplied.

title.description: Optional short human-readable label for this slice.

prompt.description: Focused task prompt for this slice.

category.description: Optional caller-provided route category for this slice. When supplied, Ennodia skips keyword classification.

harnessId.description: Optional harness ID for this slice. Omit to let Ennodia plan this slice independently.

model.description: Optional model override for this slice, passed only to harnesses that support model selection.

skillIds.description: Optional installed native skill IDs for this slice. When present, this replaces the batch-level skillIds; use an empty list to run this slice without requested skills.

items.description: One focused unit of compositional work.

slices.description: Focused work slices. Each slice resolves to at most one child task.

cwd.description: Optional working directory used to validate requested native skills.

refresh.description: Re-scan harnesses before resolving slice routes.

skillIds.description: Default installed native skill IDs for slices that omit slice.skillIds. A slice-level list, including [], replaces this default.

includeCompareEstimate.description: Include a later Judge + Result Advisor pass in the returned preflight budget estimate.

maxOutputChars.description: Maximum characters per successful slice output assumed for a later Judge + Result Advisor estimate.

maxEstimatedInputTokens.description: Fail before starting if the estimated run input tokens exceed this value.

maxChildTasks.description: Fail before starting if routing selects more child harness tasks than this value.

budget.description: Optional preflight budget limits for an Ennodia operation.

tools.name: ennodia_start
tools.description: Start raw child harness tasks without a run-level Judge + Result Advisor pass. Use for debugging, direct harness calls, or manual comparison workflows; prefer ennodia_run for normal end-to-end use.

prompt.description: The task to send to the selected local harness or harnesses.

category.description: Optional caller-provided route category. Pass this when you know the task category; Ennodia then skips keyword classification.

harnessId.description: Force one harness by ID, such as codex or claude-code. Omit to let Ennodia pick from the plan.

mode.description: single starts the selected or top-ranked harness; parallel starts every planned candidate.

cwd.description: Working directory for child harness commands.

isolateCwd.description: Run each task against an ephemeral isolated copy of cwd instead of cwd itself. Use this whenever starting more than one task against the same cwd (e.g. comparing skills or harnesses), so concurrent file writes cannot clobber each other. Isolation fails before task spawn if the copied tree contains a symbolic link. The reported task cwd is an execution trace; its temporary directory is deleted when the task becomes terminal.

model.description: Optional model override passed through to harnesses that support it.

timeoutMs.description: Per-task timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to the task manager timeout and is capped at one hour.

refresh.description: Re-scan harnesses before planning and starting tasks.

skillIds.description: Optional list of skill IDs to apply to the prompt before starting the task.

maxEstimatedInputTokens.description: Fail before starting if the estimated run input tokens exceed this value.

maxChildTasks.description: Fail before starting if routing selects more child harness tasks than this value.

budget.description: Optional preflight budget limits for an Ennodia operation.

tools.name: ennodia_start_compositional
tools.description: Start one focused child task per slice for compositional reviews. Poll the returned task IDs, then pass useful completed task IDs to ennodia_start_compare for a Judge + Result Advisor comparison.

prompt.description: Overall task or question that every slice belongs to.

id.description: Optional stable slice ID returned with the started task. Must be unique when supplied.

title.description: Optional short human-readable label for this slice.

prompt.description: Focused task prompt for this slice.

category.description: Optional caller-provided route category for this slice. When supplied, Ennodia skips keyword classification.

harnessId.description: Optional harness ID for this slice. Omit to let Ennodia plan this slice independently.

model.description: Optional model override for this slice, passed only to harnesses that support model selection.

skillIds.description: Optional installed native skill IDs for this slice. When present, this replaces the batch-level skillIds; use an empty list to run this slice without requested skills.

items.description: One focused unit of compositional work.

slices.description: Focused work slices. Each slice starts at most one child task.

cwd.description: Working directory for child harness commands.

isolateCwd.description: Run each slice's task against an ephemeral isolated copy of cwd instead of cwd itself, so slices that write files cannot clobber each other. Isolation fails before task spawn if the copied tree contains a symbolic link. The reported task cwd is an execution trace; its temporary directory is deleted when the task becomes terminal.

timeoutMs.description: Per-slice task timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to the task manager timeout and is capped at one hour.

refresh.description: Re-scan harnesses before resolving slice routes.

skillIds.description: Default installed native skill IDs for slices that omit slice.skillIds. A slice-level list, including [], replaces this default.

includeCompareEstimate.description: Include a later Judge + Result Advisor pass in the returned preflight budget estimate.

maxOutputChars.description: Maximum characters per successful slice output assumed for a later Judge + Result Advisor estimate.

maxEstimatedInputTokens.description: Fail before starting if the estimated run input tokens exceed this value.

maxChildTasks.description: Fail before starting if routing selects more child harness tasks than this value.

budget.description: Optional preflight budget limits for an Ennodia operation.

tools.name: ennodia_run
tools.description: Start a high-level Ennodia orchestration. Use this as the default entrypoint: it plans routing, starts one or more local harness tasks, optionally compares successful outputs, and returns a run ID. Runs usually take minutes; poll ennodia_get_run with sensible spacing and trust remainingMs/etaConfidence instead of aborting early.

prompt.description: The user task to route to local AI harnesses.

category.description: Optional caller-provided route category. Pass this when you know the task category; Ennodia then skips keyword classification.

harnessId.description: Force one harness by ID, such as codex or claude-code. Omit to let Ennodia plan.

mode.description: auto follows the planner; single runs one selected harness; parallel runs all candidate harnesses.

compare.description: Whether to run the Judge + Result Advisor after tasks finish. auto compares when the planner sees value and at least two tasks produce output.

cwd.description: Working directory for child harness commands.

isolateCwd.description: Run each selected harness against an ephemeral isolated copy of cwd instead of cwd itself. Use this in parallel mode or whenever comparing skills/harnesses against the same cwd, so concurrent file writes cannot clobber each other. Isolation fails before task spawn if the copied tree contains a symbolic link. The reported task cwd is an execution trace; its temporary directory is deleted when the task becomes terminal.

model.description: Optional model override passed to the selected task harnesses.

timeoutMs.description: Per-task timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to the task manager timeout and is capped at one hour.

refresh.description: Re-scan harnesses before planning the run.

judgeHarnessId.description: Harness to use as the comparison Judge. Omit to use the default priority: claude-code, codex, antigravity, opencode, kilo, kiro, cline, then hermes-agent.

judgeModel.description: Optional model override for the comparison Judge.

advisorHarnessId.description: Harness that runs the Result Advisor after the Judge. Defaults to the judge harness selection.

advisorModel.description: Optional model override for the Result Advisor.

synthesizerHarnessId.description: Deprecated alias for advisorHarnessId. Do not send both fields with different values.

synthesizerModel.description: Deprecated alias for advisorModel. Do not send both fields with different values.

maxOutputChars.description: Maximum characters from each successful task output to pass into the Judge + Result Advisor workflow. Use 0 to suppress candidate text.

skillIds.description: Optional list of skill IDs to apply to the prompt before planning and running child tasks.

maxEstimatedInputTokens.description: Fail before starting if the estimated run input tokens exceed this value.

maxChildTasks.description: Fail before starting if routing selects more child harness tasks than this value.

budget.description: Optional preflight budget limits for an Ennodia operation.

tools.name: ennodia_list_runs
tools.description: List high-level Ennodia runs started by this MCP server process.

includeEvents.description: Include bounded run event history for each listed run.

maxEvents.description: Maximum run events to include per run when includeEvents is true.

maxAnswerChars.description: Maximum final-answer characters to include per run. Use 0 to omit answer text.

tools.name: ennodia_history
tools.description: Read terminal run receipts persisted under the local Ennodia history directory. Use after a restart to inspect previous final answers and Judge disagreement analysis.

limit.description: Maximum persisted run snapshots to return, newest first.

tools.name: ennodia_get_run
tools.description: Inspect run status, selected harnesses, child task IDs, comparison ID, final Advisor answer, events, and ETA.

maxEvents.description: Maximum run events to include. Use 0 to omit events.

maxAnswerChars.description: Maximum final-answer characters to include. Use 0 to omit answer text.

tools.name: ennodia_cancel_run
tools.description: Cancel a high-level run and any active child task, Judge, or Result Advisor.

tools.name: ennodia_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks started by this Ennodia MCP server process.

includeOutput.description: Include bounded stdout and stderr previews for each task.

includeEvents.description: Include bounded task event history for each task.

maxOutputChars.description: Maximum stdout and stderr characters to include per task. Use 0 to omit output text.

maxEvents.description: Maximum task events to include per task when includeEvents is true.

tools.name: ennodia_get_compositional_status
tools.description: Inspect a batch of compositional shard tasks, group running and terminal states, and return successful task IDs ready for Judge + Result Advisor comparison.

items.description: Task ID returned by a compositional start.

prompt.description: Optional comparison prompt to include in the returned compareNext object.

minSuccessfulTasksForCompare.description: Minimum successful non-empty task outputs required before compareReady is true.

includeOutput.description: Include bounded stdout and stderr previews for each known task.

maxOutputChars.description: Maximum stdout and stderr characters to include per task when includeOutput is true.

tools.name: ennodia_start_compare
tools.description: Compare completed Ennodia task outputs or caller-supplied responses. The Judge maps agreements, contradictions, and risks; the Result Advisor then combines that analysis into the final answer. Returns a Compare ID to inspect with ennodia_get_compare.

prompt.description: Original user task or question the candidate responses answer.

taskIds.description: IDs of completed tasks from this server session to include as candidates.

responses.description: Freeform text responses to compare directly when you do not have task IDs.

id.description: Stable candidate ID used in judge analysis.

metadata.description: Optional structured metadata to retain with the candidate.

judgeHarnessId.description: Harness to use as the comparison Judge. Omit to use the default priority: claude-code, codex, antigravity, opencode, kilo, kiro, cline, then hermes-agent.

judgeModel.description: Optional model override for the comparison Judge.

advisorHarnessId.description: Harness that runs the Result Advisor after the Judge. Defaults to the judge harness selection.

advisorModel.description: Optional model override for the Result Advisor.

synthesizerHarnessId.description: Deprecated alias for advisorHarnessId. Do not send both fields with different values.

synthesizerModel.description: Deprecated alias for advisorModel. Do not send both fields with different values.

cwd.description: Working directory for Judge and Result Advisor child tasks.

timeoutMs.description: Per-child timeout for Judge and Result Advisor tasks in milliseconds, capped at one hour.

maxOutputChars.description: Maximum characters from each task output to include as a comparison candidate. Use 0 to suppress task output text.

maxEstimatedInputTokens.description: Fail before starting if the estimated run input tokens exceed this value.

maxChildTasks.description: Fail before starting if routing selects more child harness tasks than this value.

budget.description: Optional preflight budget limits for an Ennodia operation.

tools.name: ennodia_list_compares
tools.description: List Judge + Result Advisor comparisons started by this Ennodia MCP server process.

includeCandidates.description: Include bounded candidate response previews for each comparison.

includeEvents.description: Include bounded Judge + Result Advisor event history.

maxCandidateChars.description: Maximum characters to include per candidate. Use 0 to omit candidate text.

maxEvents.description: Maximum comparison events to include when includeEvents is true.

tools.name: ennodia_get_compare
tools.description: Inspect comparison status, candidate inputs, Judge analysis, Result Advisor answer, child task IDs, degradation state, and ETA.

compareId.description: Compare ID returned by ennodia_start_compare or ennodia_run.

includeEvents.description: Include bounded Judge + Result Advisor event history.

maxCandidateChars.description: Maximum characters to include per candidate. Use 0 to omit candidate text.

maxEvents.description: Maximum comparison events to include. Use 0 to omit events.

tools.name: ennodia_cancel_compare
tools.description: Cancel a running Judge + Result Advisor comparison and its active child task.

compareId.description: Compare ID returned by ennodia_start_compare or ennodia_run.

tools.name: ennodia_get_task
tools.description: Inspect task status, captured output, events, and ETA.

taskId.description: Task ID returned by a raw, compositional, advised-plan, run, Plan Advisor, or Compare start.

includeOutput.description: Include bounded stdout and stderr previews.

maxOutputChars.description: Maximum stdout and stderr characters to include. Use 0 to omit output text.

maxEvents.description: Maximum task events to include. Use 0 to omit events.

tools.name: ennodia_cancel_task
tools.description: Cancel a running task by task ID.

taskId.description: Task ID returned by a raw, compositional, advised-plan, run, Plan Advisor, or Compare start.
